💗 Dear Parent / Guardian,

Thank you for sitting with your child today! Please watch this video a few times with your child until they can do the ranking order on their own.

Practise this concept every day using things at home:
• Line up toys from small to big
• Put family members in order of height
• Count cars in a row
• Order books by size

The more they practise, the better they will become! 🌟
